sources.title: Public Holidays Act, 2024 (No. 13 of 2024, assented 2 May 2024), the Legislative Assembly of Montserrat
sources.said: 3. The public holidays set out in the Schedule, shall be kept as close holidays in all banks and public offices in Montserrat. 4. If no date is inserted in respect of a public holiday set out in the Schedule, the Governor acting on the advice of Cabinet shall by proclamation appoint a day to be reserved for the public holiday. … 9. If a public holiday coincides with another public holiday or falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the next succeeding day that is not a public holiday or a Saturday or Sunday shall be kept as a public holiday in all banks and public offices. … 15. The Public Holidays Act (Cap. 6.09) is repealed. SCHEDULE 1. The following days are annual public holidays— (a) Anniversary of the birth of the Sovereign -; (b) New Year’s Day First day of January; (c) St. Patrick’s Day 17 March; (d) Good Friday -; (e) Easter Monday -; (f) Labour Monday First Monday in May; (g) Whit Monday -; (h) Day of Prayer and Thanksgiving Second Wednesday in July; (i) Emancipation Day First Monday in August; (j) Christmas Day 25 December; (k) Boxing Day 26 December; (l) Festival Day 31 December. 2. If a public holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the succeeding Monday is a public holiday. 3. If a public holiday falls on a Saturday and a public holiday falls on the succeeding Sunday, the succeeding Monday and Tuesday are public holidays. 4. If a public holiday falls on a Saturday or a Sunday and a public holiday falls on the succeeding Monday, the succeeding Tuesday is a public holiday. 5. If two public holidays fall on the same day, the succeeding day other than a Saturday or Sunday is a public holiday.

sources.title: S.R.O. 11 of 2026, the Governor's proclamation under s. 4 of the Public Holidays Act (the Attorney General's Chambers' list of S.R.O.s)
sources.said: NOW THEREFORE, I, LINDORNA SWEENEY, Acting Governor, acting on the advice of Cabinet appoint Friday 3 April 2026 as Good Friday, a public holiday throughout Montserrat.

sources.title: S.R.O. 12 of 2026, the Governor's proclamation under s. 4 of the Public Holidays Act (the Attorney General's Chambers' list of S.R.O.s)
sources.said: NOW THEREFORE, I, LINDORNA SWEENEY, Acting Governor, acting on the advice of Cabinet appoint Monday 6 April 2026 as Easter Monday, a public holiday throughout Montserrat.

sources.title: S.R.O. 13 of 2026, the Governor's proclamation under s. 4 of the Public Holidays Act (the Attorney General's Chambers' list of S.R.O.s)
sources.said: NOW THEREFORE, I, LINDORNA SWEENEY, Acting Governor, acting on the advice of Cabinet appoint Monday 25 May 2026 as Whit Monday, a public holiday throughout Montserrat.

sources.title: S.R.O. 22 of 2026, the Governor's proclamation under s. 4 of the Public Holidays Act (the Attorney General's Chambers' list of S.R.O.s)
sources.said: NOW THEREFORE, I, HARRIET CROSS, Governor, acting on the advice of Cabinet appoint Saturday 13 June 2026 as the anniversary of the birth of the Sovereign, a public holiday throughout Montserrat.
